title: Derandomized BLR program
statement: Let $n$ and $r$ be natural numbers, and let a seed map send each $r$-bit string to an element of $(\mathbb F_2)^n$. The associated query program runs the input-stage program with this seed map and then samples an independent uniform $n$-bit input.
hypotheses_covered: A seed map from $r$-bit strings to $(\mathbb F_2)^n$
